title: TRICARE Select Deductibles and Family Catastrophic Caps
content:
Each **TRICARE Select** tier sets, per calendar plan year, an outpatient deductible per beneficiary, a deductible per sponsor family of two or more members, the service classes the deductible never applies to, and a family catastrophic cap on enrollment fees, deductibles and cost shares.

## Schedule (US dollars per calendar plan year)

The first four columns are the TRICARE Select Active Duty Family Member tiers (for example, "Group A (E-1 to E-4)" is TRICARE Select Active Duty Family Member Group A (E-1 to E-4)); the last two are TRICARE Select Retiree Group A and TRICARE Select Retiree Group B.

| | Group A (E-1 to E-4) | Group A (E-5 and Above) | Group B (E-1 to E-4) | Group B (E-5 and Above) | Retiree Group A | Retiree Group B |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Individual deductible (per beneficiary) | 50.00 | 150.00 | 61.00 | 183.00 | 150.00 | 183.00 |
| Family deductible (per sponsor family, two or more members) | 100.00 | 300.00 | 122.00 | 366.00 | 300.00 | 366.00 |
| Service classes the deductible never applies to | preventive care; emergency room visit | preventive care; emergency room visit | preventive care; emergency room visit | preventive care; emergency room visit | preventive care | preventive care; emergency room visit |
| Family catastrophic cap | 1000.00 | 1000.00 | 1252.00 | 1252.00 | 3000.00 | 4034.00 |

## Notes on the schedule

- TRICARE Select Retiree Group A is the only tier whose deductible does apply to an emergency room visit; preventive care is exempt in every tier.
- In every tier the family deductible is twice the individual deductible.
- The catastrophic cap is a family figure: one cap per sponsor family per calendar plan year, whatever the number of members enrolled.

## Points of reference (figures taken from the table)

- A TRICARE Select Active Duty Family Member Group A (E-1 to E-4) family meets its family deductible at 100.00 and its cap at 1000.00.
- A TRICARE Select Retiree Group B family has an individual deductible of 183.00 and a cap of 4034.00.
- A TRICARE Select Active Duty Family Member Group B (E-5 and Above) family's cap is 1252.00, the same as the Group B (E-1 to E-4) tier, while its deductibles of 183.00 and 366.00 are three times those of the E-1 to E-4 tier (61.00 and 122.00).
